contradictory_evidence: Infrastructure finance and announced capacity do not by themselves prove household-level reliability, affordability, groundwater recovery, or equitable rural access.
The cited documents predate September 2026 and cannot establish completion rates or present reservoir conditions.
World Bank is both financier and evaluator of its program; its implementation claims require Moroccan audit/data and independent field reporting before being treated as outcomes.
